**1 — Scene:** A roast-meat meal with mixed rice and greens, roasted vegetables, and two corn-on-the-cob rounds.

**2 — Vessel:** A large white dinner plate, partly cropped. Assuming a diameter of **26 cm**, its area is **3.14 × 13² = 531 cm²**. The dish at the upper edge is excluded.

**3 — Items:** Roast meat (likely pork loin), cooked brown/mixed rice, leafy greens, red pepper, orange roasted squash or sweet potato, and corn rounds. Some cooking fat appears present on the roasted vegetables; this is included in their energy density rather than counted separately.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Percentages represent allocated footprints, avoiding double-counting overlapping foods.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Roast pork loin | 18% | 96 × 1.7 = 163 ml | 1.0 | 163 | 210 | 342 |
| Cooked mixed rice | 15% | 80 × 1.3 = 104 ml | 0.8 | 83 | 135 | 112 |
| Leafy greens | 5% | 27 × 1.2 = 32 ml | 0.15 | 5 | 25 | 1 |
| Roasted red pepper | 4% | 21 × 0.8 = 17 ml | 0.6 | 10 | 60 | 6 |
| Roasted squash/sweet potato | 9% | 48 × 1.8 = 86 ml | 0.7 | 60 | 110 | 66 |
| Corn, edible kernels* | 12% | 64 × 2.3 = 147 ml | 0.65 | 95 | 96 | 91 |

The allocated food area totals **63%** of the plate, consistent with the visible arrangement.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **416 g of edible food and 618 kcal** is plausible for the substantial meat slice, modest rice portion, vegetables, and corn shown. Meat identity and the thickness of the cropped portions are the largest uncertainties.

*Corn weight excludes the inedible cob; the footprint and height approximate the kernel-bearing portion.*
